description: This file defines classes related to DVB Time and Date Tables (TDT and TOT), including parsing and handling of time data from MPEG sections, with class declarations and inline methods.

classes.name: TDT
classes.description: Represents the DVB Time and Date Table, capable of parsing time from MPEG section data.

classes.name: TOT
classes.description: Derived from TDT, represents the DVB Time Offset Table, providing access to descriptors.

methods.name: TDT(const MPEG::Section& data)
methods.description: Constructs TDT object by parsing MPEG section data to extract time.

methods.name: IsValid()
methods.description: Checks if the parsed time is valid.

methods.name: TOT(const MPEG::Section& data)
methods.description: Constructs TOT object from MPEG section data.

methods.name: Descriptors()
methods.description: Returns an iterator over MPEG descriptors contained in the TOT.

calls: Core::Time(year, month, day, uren, minuten, seconden, 0, false)
